role_identification_caution.entity_codes: owner_0/owner_1 and query_owner identify entities within each fixture. They are experimental bookkeeping, not a claim that Alice and Carol share a native scalar code.
role_identification_caution.basis_invariant_target: Test same-owner relations, or explicitly declared contextual binding indices derived from source record order. Do not demand an arbitrary cross-name sign convention from the network.
role_identification_caution.identification: Frozen native maps and intervention response establish a scoped role only with discriminating evidence. Coordinate sign/basis and component numbering need not be unique.
role_identification_caution.available_context: Each case retains old_statement_order, update_statement_order, owner/value spans, and token positions. Initial or updated record indices can be computed explicitly without altering prompts.
